methodology.runtime: Python 3.13, .venv/bin/python; manager probes, not terminal paint timing
methodology.cache: Independent copies of persisted surf_cache.json and surf_nft_cache.json per run; active user cache untouched
methodology.limits: Sequential views; 60 requests / 35 seconds except BOARDROOM 100 / 45 and SWARM 70 / 45. Deadline checked between synchronous projections.
methodology.rate_limit: Stopped all further live probes on first HTTP 429, from 1rpc.io/sepolia in POOL4 user view
methodology.selection: AGENT seat 420. NFT probe did not establish a selected collection or perform a network request; its total is not an NFT refresh latency.
methodology.clock: utc is probe completion time. elapsed_seconds includes construction and initial cache projection.
methodology.polls: Live script records the production busy rule at 30s; it is not a complete ReaderRuntime execution. Separate injected-clock offline probe calls production polling.
methodology.publication: publishes records cache writes, not proof of fresh successful observations or UI paint. Failed reads may store retained envelopes.
methodology.cancellation: requests_started_after_deactivate counts starts in a short 100ms drain observation; it is not a long-duration cancellation guarantee.

poll_cadence.scenario: One detached source is busy through second94; ordinary30-second polling; no real manager or thread/network
